mapper.sql: id, session_id, page_url, page_description, referrer, viewed_at, synced_to_activity, activity_id, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_website_page_view ( id, session_id, page_url, page_description, referrer, viewed_at, synced_to_activity, activity_id, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{sessionId}, #{pageUrl}, #{pageDescription}, #{referrer}, #{viewedAt}, COALESCE(#{syncedToActivity}, false), #{activityId}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, now()) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_website_page_view WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND synced_to_activity = false ORDER BY viewed_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_website_page_view SET synced_to_activity = true, activity_id = #{activityId} WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
